name: 签到全景观察与清理卫士
description: 原子聚合积分变动解析、自然日连续签到校准与可选延迟消息清理，杜绝多插件争抢。
author: TG-SignPulse

params_schema.name: balance_pattern
params_schema.label: 余额/总积分提取正则
params_schema.default: (?:总积分|当前积分|余额|剩余积分|Points|Balance)[:：\s]*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)
params_schema.description: 从回复消息中提取总积分或当前余额的正则表达式（带数字捕获组）

params_schema.name: gain_pattern
params_schema.label: 单次奖励积分提取正则
params_schema.description: 从回复消息中提取本次打卡获得积分的正则表达式（带数字捕获组）

params_schema.name: streak_pattern
params_schema.label: 连续签到天数提取正则
params_schema.default: (?:已连续签到|连续签到|连签|Streak)[:：\s]*([0-9]+)\s*天?
params_schema.description: 从回复消息中提取连续签到天数的正则表达式（带整数捕获组）

params_schema.name: enable_points
params_schema.label: 启用积分变动持久化
params_schema.description: 是否解析积分变动并原子持久化到 ledger:latest_balance

params_schema.name: enable_streak
params_schema.label: 启用连续签到校准
params_schema.description: 是否校准自然日连续签到并更新 streak:current 与 streak:last_date

params_schema.name: enable_cleanup
params_schema.label: 启用消息自动清理
params_schema.description: 打卡完成后是否自动延迟清理 Bot 回复及触发口令消息

params_schema.name: delay_seconds
params_schema.label: 清理等待时长(秒)
params_schema.description: 执行消息清理前的缓冲等待秒数

description_en: Atomically parses point changes, calibrates calendar check-in streaks, and provides optional delayed message cleanup to prevent multi-plugin contention.
features: Atomic points parsing and persistence to ledger:latest_balance
Natural calendar check-in streak calibration and persistence
Optional delayed cleanup for bot replies and user trigger commands
Idempotency guard against duplicate message event processing
Non-destructive error fallback safeguarding message traces on failure
